name: Borate Hydrolysis Reaction Benchmark
description: A set of reference quantum-chemistry reaction profiles for hydrolysis in borate networks intended to evaluate and compare computational chemistry methods.
general_score_metric: mean absolute error (MAE) of reaction/energy profiles (kcal/mol or eV)
reputation: Niche, domain-specific benchmark used in computational chemistry research for validating methods on borate hydrolysis; modest community adoption.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; dataset likely small and specialized, sensitive to level of theory; results depend on reference level (basis set / method) and may not generalize beyond borate chemistries.
